critic.fix_suggestion: For the wing engine assemblies, create four distinct pylon primitives (rectangular prisms) to bridge the gap between the wings and engines. Position these pylons at a 30-degree rearward sweep relative to the fuselage. Attach them to the underside of the wing geometry using a local offset of 15% along the spanwise axis from the fuselage, and mount the engine geometries onto the distal end of these pylons. This will resolve the 'floating' appearance and correctly distribute the engines outward along the swept wing surface.

discrepancies.reference: Engines are spaced further out along the swept wing span
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engines outward along X/Y axis
